findings.label: Edit changes type but not title
findings.detail: AddServiceItemDialog's edit branch sets ItemToEdit.Type only. Title is auto-set to '{Type} Item' at add time and is never updated on edit, so changing a Song to Scripture persists Type=Scripture but the sidebar (bound to Title) still reads 'Song Item' with a scripture icon. Update Title alongside Type in the edit branch, or add a title field to the dialog.

findings.label: Edit test does not cover the UI's actual mutation
findings.detail: EditItem_ThenSave_SurvivesRestart mutates Title and Type directly on the model, but the UI edit path never mutates Title. The round-trip is proven, yet the test gives false confidence that the edit flow persists a title change. Align the test with what the dialog mutates, or add the title field so they match.
